top: is India's FY26 methionine deficit, the largest of its eight amino-acid lines, more than lysine's $102.4 million.
volume growth in MSG imports, the one large line that is accelerating, with no Indian producer found.

sections.h2: Methionine, not lysine, is the biggest amino-acid deficit in India

chart.title: Methionine's $170.8 million deficit is almost twice lysine's $102.4 million
chart.sub: Deficit by amino acid, FY26, $ million.
chart.source: Registry table T1 in this post.

sections.means: Methionine is made by chemical synthesis from petrochemicals, so it is not a sugar-fermentation business like lysine.
sections.todo: Check whether any domestic methionine plant or DGTR case exists before treating the gap as settled.

sections.h2: MSG imports are the one large amino-acid line growing fast

chart.title: MSG import volume rose 34%, while lysine and glycine volumes fell
chart.source: Registry table T1 in this post.

sections.means: Monosodium glutamate is made by fermentation, yet no Indian producer or trade case turned up in the searches.
sections.todo: Look for Indian MSG producers and any trade complaint before deciding whether India should respond.

sections.h2: Glycine trade is nearly balanced, and India has opened a case

chart.title: Glycine imports of $19.0 million leave a deficit of only $0.6 million
chart.source: Registry table T1 in this post.

sections.means: The near-zero deficit can hide exports of one glycine grade and imports of another, which the public data cannot separate.
sections.todo: Track the DGTR glycine anti-dumping investigation opened in September 2026 and the grade and price data it turns on.
